title: Sonic Speeds Towards New Anime Debut With First Look Trailer – Watch
content: It’s hard to believe that the lovable blue speedster Sonic has been around for 35 years, and he’s arguably as popular as he’s ever been. Sonic The Hedgehog 4 will feature the debut of Amy in the big screen franchise , but at Anime Expo 2026, SEGA just revealed an epic Anime team-up featuring Amy, Sonic, Knuckles,…
author: ComicBook

title: 1st Demon Slayer: Infinity Castle Anime Film to Stream on Crunchyroll on July 28
content: Crunchyroll announced at Anime Expo on Friday that it will stream Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Infinity Castle - Akaza Sairai , the first film in the Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Infinity Castle trilogy , on its service starting on July 28 worldwide outside of Japan and Mainland China.
author: ANN

title: Sword Art Online Unanswered Butterfly Anime Reveals 19-Minute Preview Available Until July 6
content: The new Sword Art Online anime Unanswered//butterfly anime revealed a 19-minute preview, which will be deleted on July 5 at 23:59 PDT. The anime was made for the Sword Art Online: Echoes of Aincrad game, which is set in the universe of Sword Art Online and will launch globally on July 10 .
author: Anime Corner

title: Medaka Kuroiwa Is Impervious to My Charms Season 2 Premieres January 2027
content: The previously announced Season 2 of Medaka Kuroiwa Is Impervious to My Charms will premiere in January 2027. Studio SynergySP will return to animate the sequel with Yoshiaki Okumura also returning as director. The first season premiered in January 2025 with 12 episodes.
author: Anime Corner

title: The Vermilion Mask Anime Reveals 1st Main Trailer, Cast
content: The staff for the anime adaptation of Dr.Poro and Nabana Naba 's The Vermillion Mask ( Shuiro no Kamen ) manga revealed the first main trailer with English subtitles during Crunchyroll 's Anime Expo panel on Friday. The staff also revealed the cast.
author: ANN

title: Dengeki Daisy Reveals Main Cast in Teaser Trailer
content: The previously announced Dengeki Daisy anime adaptation revealed the main cast in a teaser trailer released on Saturday. The voice cast includes: • Yoshino Aoyama as Teru Kurebayashi • Taku Yashiro as Tasuku Kurosaki Sota Ueno ( Days with My Stepsister ) is directing the anime at Studio DEEN.
author: Anime Corner

title: Fate Rewinder Anime's Teaser Reveals Cast, Staff, April 2027 Debut
content: The official website for Unmei no Makimodo Shi - Fate Rewinder , the television anime adaptation of Fūta Kimura 's Unmei no Makimodo Shi - All Great Achievements Require Time manga, unveiled the anime's teaser trailer and visual on Saturday.
author: ANN

title: Dengeki Daisy Anime Reveals Main Cast in New Video
content: The staff of the television anime of Kyousuke Motomi 's Dengeki Daisy shōjo manga revealed a teaser promotional video and the two main cast members on Saturday. The teaser video was first revealed at Anime Expo on Friday. The anime stars Yoshino Aoyama as Teru Kurebayashi and Taku Yashiro as Tasuku Kurosaki.
author: ANN

title: The Ramparts of Ice Reveals Season 2 Announcement Trailer
content: The previously announced The Ramparts of Ice Season 2 revealed an announcement trailer on Saturday. The sequel is set to premiere on October 1 this year with studio KAI returning to animate.
author: Anime Corner

title: The Guy She Was Interested In Wasn't A Guy at All Anime's Teaser Reveals Cast, Staff, Nirvana Opening Song, January 2027 Debut
content: Aniplex unveiled a teaser trailer and visual for the anime adaptation of Sumiko Arai 's The Guy She Was Interested In Wasn't a Guy at All ( Ki ni Natteru Hito ga Otoko Janakatta ) manga on Saturday.
author: ANN
